Taiwan, Taoyuan Base
Steel Dragons
Hiryu Custom, Mess Hall
Huh? Is that true?
Yeah... She contacted me herself, too.@The two Fairions are being brought on the Hagane.
But doesn't the Princess have work to do back home...?
Apparently the Federation Army officially asked@for her help in the <Lamaris> extermination operation.
They even called on me and Lakis, so I guess they want@as many fighters from <The Sealing War> as they can get.
Probably.@And Rätsel and Rishu-sensei...@I hear there'll be some new members, too.
Who are they?
I wasn't told that much.
Hiryu Custom - Briefing Room
...So Sänger Sombold ended up going@to the <Endless Frontier> as well.
So, is the Boss doing well?
Yes... Well enough that he sortied in the Dygenguar@right after returning and fought Debudedabide.
That bastard... Isn't he connected to the gate@leading to the Endless Frontier after all?
One could say that's exactly why@he came to investigate in person.
I think so too, I do.
...More importantly, why have you gathered us here?
Actually, Sänger isn't the only one@who came from the Endless Frontier.
Seriously?!
Could it be someone we know, I wonder?
That's right.
Mmm, then what about me and Lamia?@We've never been to the Endless Frontier.
(Could it be...)
Hiryu Custom Hangar
Tenia
Geez, where's Melua?!
Melua
I'm right here. What is it, Tenia?
I told you the other day not to stash@candy in the cockpit, didn't I?!@Look at this! It melted and it's all sticky!
...Oh, it really is.@Okay, next time I'll stick to cookies.@Melted chocolate doesn't taste good, after all.
You idiot! Idiot, idiot, idiot, idiot!
Clifford
...I don't mind you two fighting,@but could you keep it down a little?
But look at this!
Listen, the Doctor's in the middle of adjusting it.
Touya, tell her too!@Tell her not to bring candy into the cockpit!
But Touya said it was okay.
Hey, is that true?!
No, I didn't really...
You said it.
Ahh, I think I might've said it couldn't be helped...
Touya!
Shut up! I'll clean it, okay?! Me!
Would you like some help?
Ah, no...
By the way, where's Lieutenant Calvina Coulange?@I'd like to look at the Bellzelute after this.
...She's confined to her quarters.
I see.@So that's why she didn't answer the summons...
Hiryu Custom Bridge
Miles
Orders from the Joint Chiefs of Staff.@Lift Lieutenant Calvina's confinement. Put her@on the front lines to gauge the Fury's reaction.
...Sir.
You seem surprised.@Weren't you the one who wrote in your report that@the chance she's colluding with the enemy is near zero?
That's true, but I didn't expect@a decision to come down so soon.
I agree. Now, the next matter.@Installation of the space transfer device@on the Hagane is complete.
Once the Joint Chiefs approve, we'll test the Hagane's@space transfer, with a destination off Fugui Cape,@Taiwan. After that, we head to Taoyuan Base.
What about our mission after we rendezvous?
Jakarta. Friendly units there drove off the <Lamaris>@once, but they reappeared about an hour ago.@And in greater numbers than last time.
Have any large Lamaris been confirmed?
There don't seem to be any Kaana types, but the@evacuation of residents isn't finished, so they're@stuck fighting on the defensive.
In a few more hours, containment of the@Lamaris could fail. We'll make full preparations@and then transfer to the site.
Understood.
That is all, then.
Sean
This will make our unit much lighter on its feet.
Yes...
Eun
Space distortion phenomenon right above the base!
It's not a gravity quake...?!
The distortion pattern resembles@the halo observed in Osaka!
Could it be remnants of the Dark Brain?
All hands, level-one battle stations!
The spatial distortion is intensifying!@The halo looks about to appear!
There you are, you chestnut-mash creep!
Crystal Dragoon
Roa
Kota, the Crystal Dragoon's objective is unknown.@Go carefully.
Unknown? But...
There are no Lamaris here.
Then it's gotta be after@the G Compati Kaiser, like last time!
This ship will hold at <TD Hovering>@where it is. We'll defend the base facilities.
...Calvina.@It's not the Fury we're up against, but restrain yourself.
Roger.
(If they think I'm useful as bait,@I'll make the most of it.)
Eleve 1 to all units! Commence attack!
Captain, emergency transmission from the Hagane.
Put it through to me.
That chestnut-mash creep isn't budging from there.@Ain't it after us?
Does it have some other purpose...?
Space distortion phenomenon right above the ship!@It's that halo!
Wh-What the hell is that thing?!
The Skull Knight?!
So he was alive too...!
Long time no see, Roa.@But I ain't got time to bother with ya.
What...?
What I'm after is...
That one!
Concentrate the energy field at the stern!@Evasive maneuvers!
Hmph, ya got good instincts.@But I've done what I came here for, at least.
Report damage at the hit locations!
Beam impact! Main engine nozzles on both sides@and the space transfer device are damaged!
Then a space transfer is...?!
Impossible until the device is repaired.
Of all the times for this...!
Could that have been his goal...?!
Don't you get cocky with me!@Where the hell are you from?!
Oho, the brat's all fired up.@Listen up. Clean out your ears and hear this good.
The mightiest warrior of the <Dark Brain> Army,@the great Skull Knight, that's me!
Huh? Dull Knight, ya say?
Who're you callin' dull?!
And why the hell's that skeleton freak@talkin' with a Kansai accent?
This is no time to be saying that!
All units nearby, cover the Hiryu!
Too slow, ya dope!
What?!
The Hagane?!
You transferred right to the coordinates@we sent you.
Hey, hey, that ship can jump too?@That ain't what ya told me, Chestnut.
I did not know either.
Hmph, whatever.@Fatso's the one who drew the short straw anyway.
Tetsuya
Captain, space transfer sequence complete.
Skip all system checks. Cover the Hiryu Custom.
My, my, yet more inhuman foes, eh?
Rishu-sensei!
Everyone, I have come to help you!
Princess Shine...!
Welcome back, Boss.
Yes, I'm sorry to have worried you.
So that's the Steel Dragon Team... the Steel Dragons.@I see, they're quite the colorful bunch.
So that's the Gespenst Haken...
But who's piloting it?
OK, everyone.@I'm Haken. Haken Browning.@...Just dropping in on your world for a bit.
Browning...?
Could you be a relative of Lieutenant Excellen?
That's...
Talk later. For now, drive off the enemy.
If you get in my way,@you lot ain't gettin' off free either.
OK, Skull Knight.@They do say nothing costs more than free.
What, ya know my name?@Have we met somewhere?
Nope, this is our first contact.@I meant it as a nickname, but...
Aschen
It seems it turned out to be a name that@was just as it looks, it seems, yes indeed.
I see, so it was a bingo.@Well then, Bone Fighter... let's get started!
...Hmph, ya ain't half bad.@Well, whatever. I've done what I came for,@so I'll leave it at this for today.
Let's go, Chestnut.
Understood.
Eita
All enemy signals in the combat area are gone.@No hostiles within search range.
...The Hiryu Custom's stern seems to be damaged.@Have them report their damage status at once.
Sir!
(The Crystal Dragoon, Debudedabide,@and now the Skull Knight...)
(All the Dark Brain Army's top brass, together...)
A skeleton like you is the army's strongest?!@Don't make me laugh!
Hmph, the headliner always shows up last!
Talkin' in Kansai dialect... What a weirdo!
I've talked like this from the start!
Whoever you are, I cannot fall behind@an opponent who calls himself a knight!
Dunno what you're on about, but I'll take ya on!
After a Funky Fatman, a Bone Fighter.@This world's quite the wonderland, isn't it?
Funky Fatman?@Oh, ya mean Fatso.
I'm stronger than him.@I'll show ya, and it'll cost ya your life!
Whatever you bastards are plottin',@it won't matter once I smash you here!
(I have something to do before I defeat you.)
Unlike last time, everyone in the Steel Dragons is here!@There's no way I'll lose to you!
(If anything, that is convenient. For us.)
Hey, hey!@Ya might have some big ol' wings on ya,@but that ain't what decides a fight!
(Small fry...)
It's a dragon too, but it's nothing like the RyuKoOh@or the RyuOhKi...! That thing is evil incarnate!
(Someone other than him is watching me as well...)
I can use Granteed better than I could@back at that time...@I won't let you have your way!
(This reaction... It is similar after all. Why?)
Akimi, here it comes!
We've grown a little from all the fighting so far, too!@Like I'd get scared of some dragon!
Akemi, this isn't our first fight against a monster!@Make use of that!
Right! I'll show it@the power of the Gunner Guard!
A dragon with a body like crystal, true to its name.@A worthy opponent.
My body is not what you imagine it to be.
Whatever it may be, there is nothing my sword cannot@cut! Rishu Togo, here I come!
A fragile being. Have you come to die?
I know full well that my power is small!@Even so, there are things I can do,@and that is why I came here!
Is that thing a jewel? Aschen, analysis?
I can't be imagining how much@it would be worth, just about.
OK, Money Girl.@I'd love to haul it all home, but no such luck!
Hey, hey, who said ya could stick a skull on yourself?!@Ya got some nerve!
For someone who showed up later, that's quite@an accusation, it is.
What, you're a puny one, ain'tcha?@I'll twist ya up easy!
(If it means taking him down,@I'll even play along with this circus...!)
You... Dunno why, but ya piss me off!
What's that supposed to mean?!
I just said I dunno, didn't I?!
Ya think ya can beat me with a puny drill like that?!@Then again, that robot's pretty much a toy too!
That bastard, mocking the Soul Saber!
Don't fall for his taunts! We have to be careful!
Ya think ya can beat me plinking away@with a peashooter like that?!
Like I'd fall for a taunt like that!
Hagane: Bridge
Is that true...?!
Yes. Repairing the Hiryu Custom's space transfer@device will take at least three days.
Nngh, what a mess.@And we need to hurry to Jakarta...!
Azuki
Transmission from friendly forces in Jakarta!@Debudedabide has appeared and captured@a large number of Lamaris!
Wha...!
What!?
...And so, I will be joining@the Steel Dragons once again.@I look forward to working with you all.
Katia
What's wrong, Melua?
To be able to see Her Highness Princess@Shine Hausen up this close... I'm so thrilled.
You know who I am?
Y-Yes, I'm a fan.@I've even been to the Principality of Riksent.
Oh my, is that so?
A fan...?
Princess Shine is often featured in media@covering celebrity news.@You didn't know?
Ah, I have no interest in that sort of thing.
Lord Raidi, I trust you are well.
You seem in good health too.@I never imagined the military would@turn to Her Highness for help...
Fortunately, no Lamaris have appeared in my country...@but I cannot ignore the calamity they bring.@I shall help, in my own small way.
...My friend Sänger has returned as well.@The Steel Dragons will now have the same strength@they had at the end of The Sealing War.
I've heard the Joint Chiefs had a hand@in you joining us this time too, Brother.
Yes. That's how serious the situation is.
...Rätsel, thank you for bringing@the RyuKoOh.
I've brought the Grungust Type 2 as well.
Weren't the Type 2's parts@built into the RyuJinKi?
After that rolled out, I hear they built new parts@and reassembled it.
Furthermore, not only Unit 1 but Unit 2@will also be entrusted to the Steel Dragons.
But Unit 2 was assigned to another unit, wasn't it...?
I hear Lieutenant Yon Gebana arranged for it@to be sent over.
This time we have every Grungust from Type-0@to Type-3, all together.
It's reassuring that you're joining us too, Sensei.
I thought it was about time I retired, but@this is not something I can overlook. I'll do my@best not to hold you young ones back.
Hiryu Custom - Interior
We meet again, Haken.
Hey there, Seaweed Almer.@Never thought my road would cross yours@like this.
By the way, your family name... Browning.@It's the same as Lieutenant Excellen's.@Could you two be related somehow?
Who knows?@I'm more interested in that outfit of yours.
For the record, this isn't a swimsuit. It's a DFC suit.@A tool needed for the TE Absorber's Direct@Feeling Control.
I'm no good with jargon. All I know is,@dressed like that, you could get by just fine@in the Endless Frontier.
I-It's not like I wear it because I want to!
OK, Exposure Girl. I'll answer your question, then.@The name Browning is one I inherited@from my mother... or someone like that.
Your mother...?
...I'd quit prying any further.
Oh... y-yes, ma'am.
(<Shadow Mirror>, Browning... and Axel.@The answer that leads to is...)
(I heard about it from Axel, but...)
But you can explain how those two are related, right?
Yeah, they really do look alike.
...Voice data and physique data match.@Who's this brat, I thought... but that's your real@face, then. Kota Azuma.
Oh, right.@When I was in the <Endless Frontier>,@I had the Roa Armor on the whole time.
...It's not just their looks. Their voices are identical too.
For the record, the one who's been copying me,@she would be this ugly boob-lady over here, sir.
I am W17... Lamia Loveless, I am-be.
17... I see, the teens.@Extremely cheeky for a mere greenhorn.
I'll have to drill a proper sense@of seniority into you.
You charmless, no-good little sister.@You may call me Big Sister Aschen, is what.
Understood.@Then may I explain who Big Sister is?
You have my permission, it is so be.
She is W07...@code name Aschen Brodel.
A combat android created by Shadow Mirror@before I was.
So her data has been put to use@in Lieutenant Lamia as well?
Yes. I've heard that Big Sister Aschen@is what you'd call my prototype.
(I thought it might be that... If Haken is connected@to Shadow Mirror too, then what he said@a moment ago...)
(No, that's not something I should stick my nose into.)
Thanks for explaining, green wasted flesh.@Please be taking care of me along with the Captain,@and so forth and whatnot.
Captain?
Back in my world, I'm the captain of a land battleship.@Call me Captain, Captain Haken,@or just Haken, whatever you like.
(Haken, Excellen and I... and Aschen and Lamia,@all gathered in one place...)
(Lemon... is this your doing?)
...Oh, big brother. There you are.
What is it?
Major Kai's calling for you.@He wants you to come to Briefing Room 3.
Yeah, got it.
...I called you here to hear what Roa has to say.
Okay, which monitor should I use?
Number 3.
Roa, come out.
Before we hear from him, I have a report.@Regarding the <Lamaris> occupying Jakarta...@we just received word that most of them vanished.
Vanished? Not driven off by friendly forces?
Yes... Debudedabide appeared in Jakarta,@destroyed the friendly units, and then@captured the Lamaris.
What the hell?!
...So the Skull Knight's goal was to stall us.
Yes... That's likely why he targeted@the Hiryu Custom's propulsion.
Then why didn't he sink it in one go?
I don't know.@I think there was some intention behind it, but...
...I have something to ask as well.@Why did Debudedabide capture the Lamaris?
The first possibility is to use them as their own forces.
You're saying he can control the Lamaris?
It's very likely he's been searching for a way to.
Then where is he taking the Lamaris?@The Dark Iron Castle after all?
Yes. If even the Skull Knight, who ran@the Dark Brain Army, is alive,@then it surely still exists...
But I don't think it's recovered@all of its functions.
Is there a way to find the Dark Iron Castle?
As I said before, it has advanced camouflage.@If we get close, the Compatible Kaiser's sensors@might be able to find it, but...
Could the camouflage function be damaged?
Hard to say, but it's also possible@Debudedabide has put up a barrier.
If so, that's troublesome.@The surrounding space gets twisted,@so it's not easy to reach.
Hmm... So for now we have no choice but to wait.
Commander, what will our next mission be?
There are still Lamaris left in Jakarta.@As time passes, their numbers will grow.
The Hiryu Custom will stay at Taoyuan Base@and repair its space transfer device.@The Hagane will transfer to Jakarta and...
carry out an operation devised by@Dr. Kenzou Kobayashi of the SRX Project.
